prompt: A washed-out, grainy night-mode photograph from a fixed lens high in the sloping rafters of a cramped rented attic, looking down at Brandon lying on a bare floorboard patch between a single bed and a heap of unwashed laundry, mid-crunch, brows pulled together, eyelids half shut, mouth set in a flat grim line, eyes aimed at the ceiling. A laptop open on a cardboard box glows pale blue and is the only light besides a bare bulb that barely reaches the corners. Brandon is small in the frame, seen from above, with damp patches on the slanted plaster and a kettle on a window ledge. The frame is a locked, unattended wide shot with nobody operating it, and nothing on the picture but the room. Thanks.
